project_info.theme: Blue spotlight hero for Y Le Parfum
project_info.color_palette: Midnight blue, icy blue glow, black lacquer, silver

main_subject.detail: A dark navy-black Y Le Parfum bottle stands centered against a dramatic blue spotlight backdrop. The lower copy reads 'Y LE PARFUM', 'ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG', and 'PHONG LỮ, NHỰA THÔNG, GỖ TUYẾT TÙNG, HOẮC HƯƠNG'.
main_subject.style: Luxury masculine fragrance hero packshot, sleek blue-light advertising, minimalist product dominance

composition_elements.text: Y LE PARFUM, ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG, PHONG LỮ, NHỰA THÔNG, GỖ TUYẾT TÙNG, HOẮC HƯƠNG
items: Top Left: Dark blue negative space transitioning toward a pale spotlight center
Top Right: Textured black cap with cool rim light
Bottom Left: Large bold white product name block
Bottom Right: Smaller white fragrance-note copy under the tagline
Center/Background: Glossy dark Y Le Parfum bottle with metallic Y-shaped silver band, lit by a vertical icy blue spotlight

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Strong back spotlight, glossy lacquer reflections, deep blue ambience, masculine precision

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury fragrance poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a glossy dark Y Le Parfum bottle with a metallic Y-shaped silver band, standing centered in front of a vertical icy blue spotlight on a midnight-blue background. Include the exact text 'Y LE PARFUM', 'ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG', and 'PHONG LỮ, NHỰA THÔNG, GỖ TUYẾT TÙNG, HOẮC HƯƠNG' in white at the bottom. Technical style: photoreal luxury fragrance photography, dramatic cool studio lighting, glossy lacquer reflections and deep blue ambience, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
